scientific_integrity: The analytical proof covers every integer m>=2 and 1<=r<=m. Exact rational finite checks support but do not replace the infinite theorem. No independent mathematical review or external verification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Face-balanced probability chooses each face uniformly, not globally uniform Hausdorff measure on unequal-area faces. The result treats real affine projection and does not cover higher degree, weighted faces, complex coefficients or global finite-element projectors. The volume-only endpoint is known. Priority risk remains for unindexed equivalent skeletal cubature or mass-lumping literature.
title: Sharp affine projection norms across all simplex face skeletons
